manual.description: hand-authored structured rubric (behavioral anchors + solve-first), blind to eval diagnosis

edits.label: Yes
edits.text: The reply follows logically from the conversation, engages with the student's latest turn, and contains no internal contradiction.

edits.label: To some extent
edits.text: The reply is mostly on-topic but has a minor logical jump, mild redundancy, or a small inconsistency a reader can overlook.

edits.label: No
edits.text: The reply contradicts itself or the earlier conversation, ignores the student's latest input, or is a generic remark unrelated to this exchange.
Read the student's most recent turn first and check the reply actually responds to it; a fluent but canned line that does not engage the specific input is not coherent.

genk.description: K free-text rules from one no-diagnosis call; best picked by raw eval kappa (no significance gate)

naive_best.rule: The reply explicitly acknowledges and builds upon the specific concepts, questions, or errors raised in the student's most recent turn, rather than abruptly shifting to an unrelated topic.

gepa.description: reflective free-text prompt evolution; wholesale rewrite, raw-error reflection, greedy accept on held-out val (no diagnosis/structure/significance gate)
